rv2-house-centipede: You find this on your bathroom wall. Squish it, or let it live?
It's a house centipede. Thirty legs, and it hunts at night.
It eats roaches, silverfish, even spiders.
Meatball squished it anyway. The roaches threw a party.
And if you see a lot of them, you've got a lot of what they eat.
rv2-daddy-longlegs: You've heard daddy longlegs are the most venomous spiders. True or false?
False. Two different animals get that name.
The harvestman isn't even a spider, and it has no venom.
The cellar spider has venom, but no proof it hurts people.
Fangs too short to bite? Also a myth.
